heroEyebrow: SEOUL NATIONAL UNIVERSITY · AI SYSTEM ON CHIP
heroDescription: We design efficient computing architectures and silicon systems that power the next generation of artificial intelligence.
aboutDescription: AI-SoC Laboratory explores specialized hardware systems for next-generation computing. Our research spans computer architecture, VLSI design, hardware–software co-design, and processing-in-memory, with a system-level focus on performance, energy efficiency, and scalability.
missionQuote: From algorithms to architecture. From architecture to silicon.

research.title: Deep Learning Accelerators
research.subtitle: Efficient compute for intelligent models

research.title: In-Memory Processing
research.subtitle: Moving computation closer to data
research.description: Processing-in-memory approaches that address the cost of data movement in future AI computing platforms.
